sentences.en: OK, I don't know exactly what this says about Australia, but when you win this big literary prize they have there, the Melbourne Prize for Literature, you're required to spend half the money, half of it, to get out of Melbourne and travel abroad.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我不知道这到底说明了澳大利亚的什么状况，但当你赢得当地这个极具分量的文学奖——墨尔本文学奖时，你必须花掉奖金的一半，整整一半，离开墨尔本去国外旅行。

sentences.en: Which is sort of weird, right? Like they're saying simultaneously, let's celebrate the culture of Melbourne, and then they're giving you the money to escape it.
sentences.zh: 这有点奇怪，对吧？就好像他们一方面在说，让我们来庆祝墨尔本的文化，然后又给你钱让你逃离它。

sentences.en: A few years ago when this great Australian novelist named Gerald Murnane learned that he was nominated, he asked that his name be withdrawn from consideration.
sentences.zh: 几年前，当这位伟大的澳大利亚小说家 Gerald Murnane 得知自己被提名时，他要求撤回对他的提名资格。

sentences.en: Because there was no way he was going to leave the country.
sentences.zh: 因为他绝不可能离开这个国家。

sentences.en: This is Helen Garner, an Australian who's won this prize herself, and who wrote about what happened when they wanted to give it to Murnane.
sentences.zh: 这是 Helen Garner，一位自己也得过这个奖的澳大利亚作家，她写下了他们想要把奖颁给 Murnane 时所发生的事情。

sentences.en: He's noted for the fact that he doesn't like to travel.
sentences.zh: 他以不喜欢旅行而闻名。

sentences.en: I don't think he's ever been outside Australia.
sentences.zh: 我想他大概从来没有去过澳大利亚境外。

sentences.en: And he makes a point of saying that he's never going to leave this country.
sentences.zh: 而且他明确表示，他永远不会离开这个国家。

sentences.en: He's never wanted to, and he thinks that everything one needs to know could be known just as well here as anywhere else in the world.
sentences.zh: 他从来不想离开，并且认为一个人需要了解的一切，在这里和世界上任何其他地方都能同样好地了解到。

sentences.en: But he's this deeply original writer, and the committee decided to bend the rules for him.
sentences.zh: 但他是一位极具独创性的作家，委员会决定为他破例。

sentences.en: Helen was in the auditorium when he received the award.
sentences.zh: Helen 当时就在他领奖的礼堂里。

sentences.en: And he was obviously in his rather inward introverted sort of way terribly happy to have won the prize.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他带着那种有些内向、自省的方式，对赢得这个奖感到无比高兴。

sentences.en: And he explained to the audience his stand on international travel.
sentences.zh: 他向观众阐述了自己对国际旅行的立场。

sentences.en: But he said, in the spirit of the prize, he would do something else.
sentences.zh: 但他说，本着这个奖的精神，他会做点别的事。

sentences.en: He would use some of the prize money to fill his car with gas and drive around to some of the places that he had lived in and around Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 他要用一部分奖金给汽车加满油，然后开车去他和墨尔本周边一些他曾经住过的地方转转。

sentences.en: And that was when the speech became really wonderful, because he just kind of tilted his head back and closed his eyes and reeled off this list of addresses, his former addresses in the suburbs of Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 也就是在这个时候，这段演讲变得极其精彩，因为他只是把头往后一仰，闭上眼睛，一口气背出了一连串地址，他在墨尔本郊区的旧住址。

sentences.en: And they were very undistinguished parts of town.
sentences.zh: 那些都是城里非常不起眼的地方。

sentences.en: They're the very obscure suburbs that nobody ever talks about and nothing dramatic ever seems to happen there.
sentences.zh: 那是些极其偏僻的郊区，平时没人提起，也似乎从不会发生什么戏剧性的事情。

sentences.en: And he reeled them off like somebody chanting or praying by heart.
sentences.zh: 他像是在背诵经文或默默祈祷一样，一口气把它们念了出来。

sentences.en: He had them all by heart in chronological order.
sentences.zh: 他把它们按时间顺序全部记在心里。

sentences.en: Yes, all right. We would say The Avenue, Coburg; Breese Street, Brunswick; Plenty Road, Bundoora.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。我们会说：科堡的大道街；布伦瑞克的布里斯街；邦多拉的普伦蒂路。

sentences.en: There's no recording of this speech, but when I phoned Gerald Murnane at his home, he was able to recite for me all 20 locations from memory in the order that he lived in them.
sentences.zh: 这段演讲没有录音，但当我给 Gerald Murnane 家打电话时，他凭记忆向我背出了全部 20 个地点，而且顺序正是他曾经居住的顺序。

sentences.en: And the end of the list is Ray Street, Pascoe Vale; Bakers Road, North Coburg; Peter Street, South Oakleigh; and then Legon Road, South Oakley; and then Filbert Street, South Caulfied.
sentences.zh: 名单的结尾是：帕斯科维尔的雷街；北科堡的贝克斯路；南奥克兰的彼得街；然后是南奥克兰的利贡路；还有南考尔菲德的菲尔伯特街。

sentences.en: What we knew was that he was really reciting a kind of a poem of such modestly named places that had such meaning to him.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，他其实是在朗诵一首诗，关于那些名字平平无奇、却对他有着如此重大意义的地方。

sentences.en: Gweno Avenue, Frankston; Fitzroy Street in Kilda; River Street, South Yarra.
sentences.zh: 法兰斯顿的格韦诺大道；圣基尔达的菲茨罗伊街；南亚拉的里弗街。

sentences.en: And there was something so wonderful about it.
sentences.zh: 这一切有一种难以言喻的美妙。

sentences.en: And then when he finished and opened his eyes and looked around, the whole place just went up in a roar where everyone was delighted, and half laughing, and half tearful.
sentences.zh: 然后当他念完、睁开眼睛环顾四周时，全场顿时爆发出一阵欢呼，每个人都欣喜若狂，半是欢笑，半是泪水。

sentences.en: It was very moving and wonderful. I'm terribly glad that I was there.
sentences.zh: 非常感人，也非常精彩。我无比庆幸自己当时在场。

sentences.en: Gerald Murnane told me even he was moved by it.
sentences.zh: Gerald Murnane 告诉我，连他自己也被这情景打动了。

sentences.en: Place and locality and these things, they do matter much to me.
sentences.zh: 地方、地理位置这些东西，对我的确非常重要。

sentences.en: I've got this sort of mental geography. In a way, it's probably been bred into me by the fact that I move so often.
sentences.zh: 我有一种这样的心理地理学。在某种程度上，这可能是因为我搬家太频繁而刻进我骨子里的。

sentences.en: We moved almost every year because my father was a gambler on race horses and also a reckless man who was always looking for-- he just couldn't sit in one place.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎每年都搬家，因为我父亲是个赛马赌徒，同时也是个鲁莽的人，总是在寻找——他就是坐不住。

sentences.en: We lived at all these different addresses. (INTERVIEW) IRA GLASS: When you list them off like that, is the feeling nostalgia, or is it even stronger?
sentences.zh: 我们住过所有这些不同的地址。（采访）IRA GLASS：当你像这样把它们列举出来时，这种感觉是怀旧，还是更强烈？

sentences.en: Is it a feeling of like, this is me, that in some way you're describing yourself?
sentences.zh: 是一种“这就是我”的感觉，就好像你在某种程度上是在描述你自己？

sentences.en: You nearly got it right, then-- I feel a sense of pride-- I'm not boasting, but I feel a sense of pride that I survived all that.
sentences.zh: 你当时差不多说对了——我有一种自豪感——我不是在炫耀，但我确实为自己挺过来这一切而感到自豪。

sentences.en: I mean, when I say survive, we were quite poor. (INTERVIEW) IRA GLASS: I grew up in the suburbs of Baltimore, which is a city not far from Washington, DC.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当我说挺过来时，我们其实挺穷的。（采访）IRA GLASS：我在巴尔的摩的郊区长大，那是一个离华盛顿特区不远的城市。

sentences.en: Baltimore, Maryland. (INTERVIEW) IRA GLASS: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 马里兰州巴尔的摩。（采访）IRA GLASS：对，对。

sentences.en: Baltimore, Maryland. And when I look back on it, I feel like I understand that it shaped me in certain ways.
sentences.zh: 马里兰州巴尔的摩。当我回首往事时，我觉得我明白是它在某些方面塑造了我。

sentences.en: But I also feel like this is just a random place that happened to be the place that I grew up.
sentences.zh: 但我也觉得，这只是一个碰巧让我长大的随机地方。

sentences.en: Like, there's nothing special about it. I feel no attachment to it.
sentences.zh: 就像，它没有什么特别之处。我对它没有任何依恋。

sentences.en: I have no sentimental feelings about the place.
sentences.zh: 我对这个地方没有任何感伤的情怀。

sentences.en: And is your attachment to these places now that they seem special in some way, or are they simply familiar?
sentences.zh: 那么你对这些地方的依恋，是因为它们在某种程度上显得很特别，还是仅仅因为熟悉？

sentences.en: Well, they certainly don't feel special, and I've said already that I don't go back to visit them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它们当然不觉得特别，而且我之前已经说过，我不会回去看它们。

sentences.en: I'm not attached to these places. They attached themselves to me in a sense.
sentences.zh: 我对这些地方没有依恋。从某种意义上说，是它们依恋上了我。

sentences.en: And I don't want to go back there. I don't want to be the person I was then.
sentences.zh: 我不想回到那里去。我不想再做当年的那个自己。

sentences.en: But I do want to remember them. I can't put it any better than that. (INTERVIEW) IRA GLASS: Why?
sentences.zh: 但我确实想记住它们。我无法用更好的语言来表达了。（采访）IRA GLASS：为什么？

sentences.en: Remember them, because they made me. The combination of all the strange experiences that I had, or lack of experience, or yearnings, or unfulfilled wants, they made me.
sentences.zh: 记住它们，因为它们造就了我。我所经历的所有奇怪经历的组合，或者缺乏经历，或者渴望，或者未竟的心愿，它们造就了我。

sentences.en: Well, today on our program, we don't choose where we grow up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，今天在我们的节目中，我们无法选择自己在哪里长大。

sentences.en: We don't choose the family we're born into.
sentences.zh: 我们无法选择自己出生的家庭。

sentences.en: And when we head out into the bigger world, that's the private geography we carry with us.
sentences.zh: 当我们走向更广阔的世界时，那就是我们随身携带的私人地理。

sentences.en: Today, we have two stories where we see what that geography reveals about two very different people.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们有两个故事，从中我们可以看到这种地理揭示了两个截然不同的人。

sentences.en: One of them, current Secretary of Education, Betsy DeVos.
sentences.zh: 其中一位，是现任教育部长 Betsy DeVos。

sentences.en: From WBEZ Chicago, it's This American Life.
sentences.zh: 来自芝加哥 WBEZ 电台，这里是《这个美国生活》。

sentences.en: I'm Ira Glass. Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 我是 Ira Glass。请继续收听。

sentences.en: Act one, Vouching towards Bethlehem. So the issue that our Secretary of Education, Betsy DeVos, has fought hardest for over the years, the issue that she hopes to engage as education secretary, is school choice in all of its forms.
sentences.zh: 第一幕，向伯利恒迈进。多年来，我们的教育部长 Betsy DeVos 为之奋斗最力的议题，也是她希望作为教育部长着手解决的议题，就是各种形式的择校。

sentences.en: One of those forms? School choice means fostering a system of charter schools as alternatives to the regular public school system.
sentences.zh: 其中一种形式是什么？择校意味着扶持一个特许学校系统，作为常规公立学校系统的替代方案。

sentences.en: These schools are supposed to be laboratories of great teaching, places where some of the rules and regulations of regular public schools don't apply.
sentences.zh: 这些学校本应是卓越教学的实验室，在这里，常规公立学校的一些规章制度不再适用。

sentences.en: School choice also means vouchers, which, of course, lets parents pull their kids out of public schools, and put them into parochial schools, or church schools, or private schools of all kinds.
sentences.zh: 择校也意味着教育券，当然，这可以让家长把孩子从公立学校抽出来，送进教会学校、宗教学校或各种私立学校。

sentences.en: And state money that had gone to the public schools would follow the children with a voucher to the private schools they enroll in.
sentences.zh: 原本拨给公立学校的国家资金，将随着持有教育券的孩子一起转入他们就读的私立学校。

sentences.en: DeVos says her interest in all this started when her son was entering Kindergarten.
sentences.zh: DeVos 说，她对这一切的兴趣始于她儿子上幼儿园的时候。

sentences.en: She realized that she had the means to send him to any school she wanted to.
sentences.zh: 她意识到自己有能力把儿子送到她想让他去的任何学校。

sentences.en: She had a lot of money. Why shouldn't every parent be able to do that?
sentences.zh: 她有很多钱。为什么每个家长不应该都能做到这一点呢？

sentences.en: So we decided at that time to help some other kids have the same opportunity as our children.
sentences.zh: 所以我们当时决定帮助其他一些孩子拥有和我们孩子一样的机会。

sentences.en: We started work with that school, and then more broadly in our community funding scholarships, and realized very quickly that while we were helping individual children, which was important, it wasn't an effort that was particularly scalable.
sentences.zh: 我们开始与那所学校合作，接着在我们的社区更广泛地资助奖学金，并且很快意识到，虽然我们在帮助个别儿童，这很重要，但这种努力并不是特别具有可扩展性。

sentences.en: So I really decided to get involved in public policy, which I thought was going to make the most difference.
sentences.zh: 所以我真正决定投身于公共政策，我认为这会带来最大的改变。

sentences.en: Betsy DeVos made it into the President's cabinet with as low a vote as you can get and still squeak by.
sentences.zh: Betsy DeVos 以微弱得不能再险的票数进入了内阁。

sentences.en: It was the first time in U.S. history that the Vice President has had to cast a tie-breaking vote to confirm a cabinet secretary.
sentences.zh: 这是美国历史上第一次由副总统投出打破僵局的关键票来确认一名内阁部长的任命。

sentences.en: She'd been an education advocate for decades, pushing for choice and vouchers in Michigan, where she's from.
sentences.zh: 几十年来她一直是一位教育倡导者，在她的家乡密歇根州大力推动择校制和教育券。

sentences.en: Her critics said she was a know-nothing, just some rich Republican donor with no qualifications for the job of education secretary, and specifically, no experience in the public schools.
sentences.zh: 她的批评者称她为什么都不懂的白痴，只不过是一个毫无教育部长资格、尤其是没有任何公立学校工作经验的富有共和党捐款人。

sentences.en: That was the rap against her. One of our producers, Susan Burton, grew up in the same home town as Betsy DeVos, Grand Rapids, Michigan, and has been aware of the DeVos family since she was a little kid.
sentences.zh: 这就是对她的种种指责。我们的制作人之一 Susan Burton 与 Betsy DeVos 来自同一个家乡——密歇根州大急流城，从小就对 DeVos 家族有所耳闻。

sentences.en: There are certain things you can learn about Betsy DeVos and her agenda by going to Grand Rapids.
sentences.zh: 通过去大急流城，你可以了解到关于 Betsy DeVos 及其政治议程的一些特定事情。

sentences.en: Here's Susan. One of the things you'd hear over and over in the weeks leading up to Betsy DeVos's confirmation hearings was that she'd never set foot in a public school.
sentences.zh: 下面是 Susan 的讲述。在 Betsy DeVos 确认听证会前几周，你一再听到的一件事就是她从未涉足过公立学校。

sentences.en: It was often phrased exactly this way. People said it to news reporters, repeated it in speeches.
sentences.zh: 这句话通常就是这么说的。人们对新闻记者这样说，在演讲中也反复提及。

sentences.en: Betsy DeVos has never set foot in a public school.
sentences.zh: Betsy DeVos 从未涉足过公立学校。

sentences.en: This woman has never stepped foot in a public school.
sentences.zh: 这个女人从未踏足过公立学校。

sentences.en: He nominated a woman who had never worked in, volunteered in, ever stepped foot in a public school until he chose her to be his Secretary of Education.
sentences.zh: 他提名了一位从未在公立学校工作过、做过志愿者、甚至从未踏足过公立学校的女性，直到他选择她担任教育部长。

sentences.en: That's the head of one of the two national teachers unions.
sentences.zh: 那是全美两大教师工会之一的负责人。

sentences.en: But when I talked to people in Grand Rapids, I heard a different story, that she had spent time in a public school, volunteering as a mentor.
sentences.zh: 但当我与大急流城的人交谈时，我听到了不同的说法，那就是她确实在公立学校待过，作为志愿者担任过导师。

sentences.en: At first, nobody could give me details. It was all rumors and secondhand information.
sentences.zh: 起初，没有人能提供具体细节。全都是传言和二手消息。

sentences.en: Here's Elizabeth Welch, a local public school advocate.
sentences.zh: 这位是 Elizabeth Welch，当地的一位公立学校倡导者。

sentences.en: In just community conversations with people, we knew she hadn't been deeply involved in Grand Rapids Public.
sentences.zh: 在与大家的日常交流中，我们知道她并没有深度参与过Grand Rapids Public。

sentences.en: And so, I was through a few discussions where it was through the grapevine I had heard, oh, I heard she tutored some kids at Burton Elementary.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是通过一些小道消息听说，哦，听说她在Burton Elementary辅导过一些孩子。

sentences.en: Well, I had heard that she had said she had done that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我听说她自己说过她做过那种事。

sentences.en: But I didn't know where. This is Mary Bouwense, the head of the local teacher's union.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道在哪里。这是Mary Bouwense，当地教师工会的负责人。

sentences.en: Because when she said I tutored in Grand Rapids, well, she could have been tutoring at one of the Christian elementaries.
sentences.zh: 因为当她说我在Grand Rapids辅导过时，她也可能是在某所基督教小学辅导。

sentences.en: You know, it could have been in the area of Grand Rapids, 'cause sometimes people say Grand Rapids, but they mean Kentwood, or Wyoming, or one of the suburbs too.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那可能在Grand Rapids周边，因为有时人们嘴上说Grand Rapids，但他们指的是Kentwood、Wyoming，或者是其中的某个郊区。

sentences.en: They just say Grand Rapids as a general term.
sentences.zh: 他们只是把Grand Rapids当成一个泛称。

sentences.en: So I just assumed it was going to be the Christian schools that she tutored in when she showed up, because a lot of their money goes into those buildings.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时就想当然地以为，她去辅导的肯定是那些基督教学校，因为他们的很多资金都投入到了那些建筑上。

sentences.en: So. I'm from Grand Rapids, so I knew what Mary was talking about, the schools associated with the Christian Reformed Church.
sentences.zh: 所以。我是土生土长的Grand Rapids人，所以我明白Mary在说什么，那些与基督教改革宗有关的学校。

sentences.en: I have friends who went to these schools.
sentences.zh: 我有些朋友就上过这些学校。

sentences.en: My next door neighbor, Jason, went to Ada Christian.
sentences.zh: 我的邻居Jason就上了Ada Christian。

sentences.en: So did Jenny from swim team. Nicole from acting went to Seymour Christian.
sentences.zh: 游泳队的Jenny也是。演话剧的Nicole上了Seymour Christian。

sentences.en: Betsy DeVos went to these schools, and also sent her own four children there.
sentences.zh: Betsy DeVos上过这些学校，后来还把她自己的四个孩子也送到了那里。

sentences.en: The Christian Reformed Church has its own history of school choice.
sentences.zh: 基督教改革宗本身就有选择学校的历史。

sentences.en: Back in the 1850s, a group of Dutch settlers in West Michigan split off from their church to form their own denomination.
sentences.zh: 早在19世纪50年代，西密歇根州的一群荷兰定居者脱离了他们的教会，组成了自己的教派。

sentences.en: And one of the big reasons-- they didn't want their children in public schools.
sentences.zh: 其中一个主要原因——他们不想让自己的孩子去公立学校。

sentences.en: They wanted their children to be formed in the faith, in their own schools, before sending them out into the world.
sentences.zh: 他们希望在把孩子送入世界之前，先在自己的学校里用信仰去塑造他们。

sentences.en: The idea that parents of all backgrounds should be able to choose a school reflecting their values and beliefs, that's part of the theological history of the CRC.
sentences.zh: 所有背景的父母都应该能够选择一所体现其价值观和信仰的学校，这个理念正是CRC神学历史的一部分。

sentences.en: At first, I had a hard time finding people to talk about Betsy DeVos and the public school she volunteered in, partly because the DeVoses are such a prominent family in Grand Rapids.
sentences.zh: 起初，我很难找到愿意谈论Betsy DeVos以及她曾做过志愿者的那所公立学校的人，部分原因是因为DeVos家族在Grand Rapids是个显赫的家族。

sentences.en: They're major philanthropists. Lots of buildings have the DeVos name on them.
sentences.zh: 他们是大慈善家。很多建筑上都刻着DeVos的名字。

sentences.en: At age 10, I performed "It's a Hard Knock Life" from Annie with seven other girls on the stage in DeVos Hall, which is inside DeVos Place, which isn't so far from the Helen DeVos Children's Hospital, the Richard M.
sentences.zh: 在我10岁的时候，我和另外七个女孩一起在DeVos Hall的舞台上表演了来自《安妮》的《It's a Hard Knock Life》，这里位于DeVos Place内部，距离Helen DeVos儿童医院、Richard M.

sentences.en: DeVos Center, and a bit further out, the DeVos Center for Arts and Worship at Grand Rapids Christian High School.
sentences.zh: DeVos中心不远，再远一点还有Grand Rapids Christian高中的DeVos艺术与崇拜中心。

sentences.en: The DeVos fortune comes from Amway. When I was a little girl, I wasn't exactly sure what Amway did.
sentences.zh: DeVos家族的财富来自Amway。当我还是个小女孩的时候，我其实并不清楚Amway是做什么的。

sentences.en: Sold stuff in a weird way, not in stores.
sentences.zh: 以一种奇怪的方式卖东西，不在商店里卖。

sentences.en: Betsy DeVos married the eldest son of Amway's founder, but she's also from an iconic local family.
sentences.zh: Betsy DeVos嫁给了Amway创始人的长子，但她自己也来自一个当地极具代表性的家族。

sentences.en: Her father, Edgar Prince, made his millions in West Michigan as an auto parts manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲Edgar Prince作为汽车零部件制造商，在西密歇根州赚取了数百万身家。

sentences.en: One of his inventions? The light up mirror visor.
sentences.zh: 他的一项发明是什么？带灯光的遮阳板化妆镜。

sentences.en: I finally did reach someone who'd been at the public school Betsy DeVos volunteered at, Burton Elementary.
sentences.zh: 我最终联系到了一个曾与Betsy DeVos做过志愿者的公立学校——Burton Elementary共事过的人。

sentences.en: I'm Susan Burton, but that's not my family's name on the building, by the way.
sentences.zh: 我是Susan Burton，顺便说一下，大楼上可不是我们家族的名字。

sentences.en: The woman I reached, I'll call her Denise.
sentences.zh: 我联系到的那个女人，我叫她Denise吧。

sentences.en: A lot of teachers were like, she's never been in one of our schools.
sentences.zh: 很多老师都说，她从来没进过我们的学校。

sentences.en: And I said, well, no, she has. I've seen her.
sentences.zh: 而我说，不对，她来过。我见过的。

sentences.en: What? You know, they couldn't believe that she even set foot in a public school, and in a Grand Rapids public school.
sentences.zh: 什么？你知道的，他们简直不敢相信她竟然真的踏足过公立学校，而且还是一所Grand Rapids的公立学校。

sentences.en: They could not believe it. Yeah, they were shocked.
sentences.zh: 他们简直不敢相信。是的，他们惊呆了。

sentences.en: Denise used to be a teacher at Burton, the Grand Rapids public school where it turns out Betsy DeVos volunteered for five years.
sentences.zh: Denise以前是Burton的一名老师，这所Grand Rapids的公立学校后来证明就是Betsy DeVos做过五年志愿者的地方。

sentences.en: As far as I can tell, it's the most sustained encounter with a public school that she's ever had, and Betsy DeVos says it affected her deeply.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这是她经历过的与公立学校最持久的一次接触，而Betsy DeVos表示这深深地影响了她。

sentences.en: She didn't respond to any of the questions or interview requests I sent to the Department of Education, but she did talk briefly about the experience at her confirmation hearing in January.
sentences.zh: 她没有回复我发给教育部的好几个问题或采访请求，但她在1月份的提名听证会上简短地谈到了这段经历。

sentences.en: I've worked as an in-school mentor for students in the Grand Rapids Public Schools, and have had the privilege of interacting with students and their families and teachers in ways that have changed my life and my perspective about education forever.
sentences.zh: 我曾担任Grand Rapids公立学校学生的校内导师，并有幸以各种方式与学生、他们的家庭以及老师们进行互动，这些经历永远改变了我的人生和对教育的看法。

sentences.en: Here's how Betsy DeVos wound up at Burton Elementary back in 2003.
sentences.zh: 以下是Betsy DeVos当年在2003年如何来到Burton Elementary的经过。

sentences.en: She was not a random parent walking in to help out.
sentences.zh: 她并不是一个偶然走进来帮忙的普通家长。

sentences.en: She was one of the most powerful educational activists in the state, a major Republican donor.
sentences.zh: 她是该州最有权势的教育活动家之一，也是一名主要的共和党捐款人。

sentences.en: Since the early '90s, she'd been advocating for increased choice in Michigan schools.
sentences.zh: 自20世纪90年代初以来，她一直在倡导增加密歇根州学校的选择权。

sentences.en: In 1993, she helped the governor make Michigan one of the first states in the nation to allow charter schools.
sentences.zh: 1993年，她协助州长使密歇根州成为全国最早允许设立特许学校的州之一。

sentences.en: In 2000, she introduced a ballot measure to get vouchers in the state.
sentences.zh: 2000年，她提出了一项在全州推行教育券的投票议案。

sentences.en: At the time, she was the chair of the state Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 当时，她是州共和党的主席。

sentences.en: The governor didn't support her measure, so she quit.
sentences.zh: 州长不支持她的议案，于是她辞职了。

sentences.en: It was that important to her. She and her husband spent more than $2 million of their own money to promote the measure.
sentences.zh: 这对她来说就是这么重要。她和丈夫自掏腰包花了两百多万美元来推动这项议案。

sentences.en: The campaign flew people to see voucher schools in Milwaukee on a private Amway jet.
sentences.zh: 竞选团队甚至用一架Amway的私人飞机，载着人们去密尔沃基参观教育券学校。

sentences.en: When voters rejected the measure, she spent even more to influence legislators.
sentences.zh: 当选民否决了这项议案时，她花了更多钱去影响立法者。

sentences.en: She started lobbying groups at the state and national level.
sentences.zh: 她在州和国家层面都成立了游说集团。

sentences.en: Her former lobbying director told me that when somebody challenged her about what she was going to do to make local public schools better, she signed up to mentor students.
sentences.zh: 她前任的游说主管告诉我，当有人质疑她将如何改善当地公立学校时，她报名去给学生当导师了。

sentences.en: She did this through a group called Kids Hope USA.
sentences.zh: 她是通过一个名叫Kids Hope USA的组织做到这一点的。

sentences.en: It's a national organization that pairs churches with public schools.
sentences.zh: 这是一个将教会与公立学校配对的全国性组织。

sentences.en: She was in the first group of mentors from her church.
sentences.zh: 她是他们教会第一批导师中的一员。

sentences.en: Sharon Olette was in charge of the Kids Hope USA program at their church for years.
sentences.zh: Sharon Olette多年来一直负责他们教会的Kids Hope USA项目。

sentences.en: She says they knew the kind of school they wanted to partner with and set out to find it.
sentences.zh: 她说，他们知道自己想要合作的是哪种学校，并着手去寻找它。

sentences.en: I mean, we're a very Caucasian, white America church and didn't have the opportunity to interact with inner city kids and the Hispanic community like we wanted to.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们是一个非常纯白人的美国教会，没有机会像我们想要的那样与内城孩子和拉美裔社区进行互动。

sentences.en: And this was such a wonderful avenue for us to do that, to really live out our faith.
sentences.zh: 而这为我们提供了一个绝佳的途径，让我们能够真正践行我们的信仰。

sentences.en: And one of the pastors at the time just drove around the inner city and looked at the different schools and was kind of praying over all of that situation, what school we should partner with.
sentences.zh: 当时的一位牧师只是开车在内城转了转，查看了不同的学校，并为所有这些情况祈祷，思考我们应该与哪所学校合作。

sentences.en: And he had actually another school in mind, and he happened to go by Burton Elementary, and he said it was just clear to him that God was saying this is the one.
sentences.zh: 其实他心里已经有了另一所学校，但碰巧路过了Burton Elementary，他说他当时清楚地感受到上帝在说就是这所。

sentences.en: This is the school. So that's kind of an exciting story.
sentences.zh: 就是这所学校。所以这算是一个挺让人激动的故事。

sentences.en: The volunteer mentors were not teaching religion.
sentences.zh: 志愿导师们并不是在教宗教。

sentences.en: They were just there to mentor the kids, every week for one hour.
sentences.zh: 他们只是去辅导孩子们，每周一次，每次一小时。

sentences.en: The kids at Burton are mostly Latino, speak Spanish as a first language, and they're almost all poor.
sentences.zh: Burton的学生大多是拉丁裔，母语是西班牙语，而且几乎全都是穷人。

sentences.en: Denise, the former teacher, was proud of the work she did that.
sentences.zh: 前教师Denise为她当时所做的工作感到自豪。

sentences.en: The school had a great principal, and Denise felt like she was part of a dedicated staff, a group giving it's all, trying to help these students with the limited resources they had.
sentences.zh: 学校有一位很棒的校长，Denise觉得自己是一支敬业团队的一员，大家都在全力以赴，试图用有限的资源帮助这些学生。

sentences.en: Into that walks Betsy DeVos. And then I still remember the first time I ever saw her walking down the hallway in a really, really just old school.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，Betsy DeVos走了进来。然后我仍然记得我第一次看到她走在一条非常非常老旧的学校走廊里。

sentences.en: Burton Elementary's a really old school, and just drinking fountains that didn't work, and the bathrooms that didn't have soap.
sentences.zh: Burton Elementary是一所非常老旧的学校，饮水机不能用，洗手间里没有肥皂。

sentences.en: And there she was in her $1,000 suit and her really pretty shoes.
sentences.zh: 而她就站在那里，穿着一件价值一千美元的套装和非常漂亮的鞋子。

sentences.en: And I just thought how odd she looked. She just looked so out of place.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得她看起来多格格不入啊。她看起来太突兀了。

sentences.en: She had this beautiful like, tan camel hair jacket.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一件非常漂亮的类似驼绒的夹克。

sentences.en: And just the visual of her walking through and looking at everything.
sentences.zh: 还有她走过并环顾四周的那个画面。

sentences.en: And I remember the story being told of that her husband would drop her off because she didn't want to park her car in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 我还记得当时流传的一个说法，说是她丈夫会开车送她过来，因为她不想把车停在停车场里。

sentences.en: Like, were the cars at risk of being broken into?
sentences.zh: 难道是车有被砸的风险吗？

sentences.en: Was that the idea, that-- I don't know. I really don't know what was running through her head.
sentences.zh: 是这个意思吗，我不知道。我真的不知道她脑子里在想什么。

sentences.en: Three other people who worked at Burton in those years told me Betsy DeVos had a driver who'd drop her off.
sentences.zh: 当年在Burton工作的另外三个人告诉我，Betsy DeVos有一个专职司机送她来。

sentences.en: One said he'd park a big black SUV up on the sidewalk near the school's front door and wait there until she came out.
sentences.zh: 其中一人说，他会把一辆巨大的黑色SUV停在学校正门附近的步行道上，然后一直在那里等她出来。

sentences.en: Betsy DeVos was assigned to mentor a little girl in third grade.
sentences.zh: Betsy DeVos被指派去辅导一个读三年级的小女孩。

sentences.en: She was a girl who needed extra attention in the classroom, and outside school, her housing situation was unstable.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在课堂上需要格外关注的小女孩，而在学校之外，她的居住情况也不稳定。

sentences.en: Again, Denise. You know, her living situation was really difficult.
sentences.zh: 还是Denise的话。你知道的，她的生活状况真的很艰难。

sentences.en: Many times, she just came to school hungry.
sentences.zh: 许多时候，她饿着肚子来学校。

sentences.en: She came to school tired.
sentences.zh: 她来学校时筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: It was a sad situation. Denise says when Betsy DeVos came to school, with the teachers, she was cordial, but not overly friendly.
sentences.zh: 那是个让人难过的状况。Denise说，当Betsy DeVos来到学校时，她对老师们很客气，但并不算十分亲切。

sentences.en: Denise was wary of her. But I talked to a counselor at the school, a social worker I'll call Megan who knew the little girl, and interacted with her, and who appreciated what Betsy DeVos was trying to do.
sentences.zh: Denise对她有所戒备。不过我和学校里的一位辅导员聊过，我暂且叫她Megan，她认识那个小女孩，也和她互动过，并且很赞赏Betsy DeVos所做的事。

sentences.en: I thought it was great that she was taking an interest in our lower income school.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她对我们这所低收入学校感兴趣，这太棒了。

sentences.en: So I remember the student telling me, Miss Betsy was here this week, and just feeling special because another adult took interest in her.
sentences.zh: 所以我记得那个学生跟我说，Betsy女士这周来过了，她觉得自己很特别，因为有另一个成年人关心她。

sentences.en: The little girl would talk to Megan about the mentoring.
sentences.zh: 小女孩会和Megan聊起指导的事情。

sentences.en: The attention pleased her, made her proud.
sentences.zh: 这份关注让她很高兴，也让她感到自豪。

sentences.en: And then one day, the little girl had some other news to share about Betsy DeVos.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，小女孩带来了关于Betsy DeVos的另一个消息。

sentences.en: The student told me that she purchased a car for her mom.
sentences.zh: 这个学生告诉我，她为她妈妈买了一辆车。

sentences.en: Her mom was having a hard time getting to her employer.
sentences.zh: 她妈妈很难通勤去上班。

sentences.en: And so to keep that momentum going with her employment, I know she purchased a car and did other things for the family beyond the school.
sentences.zh: 为了保持她工作的势头，我知道她买了一辆车，并在学校之外为这个家庭做了其他事情。

sentences.en: Four different people at the school told me about the car.
sentences.zh: 学校里有四个人向我提起过这辆车。

sentences.en: One said it came up at a staff meeting. Teachers thought it was great news for the family, but they also struggled with what to make of this kind of generosity, and whether buying the mother a car was setting her up for failure or success.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人说，在一次全体教职工会议上提到了这件事。老师们觉得这对这个家庭来说是个好消息，但他们也很纠结，不知道该如何看待这种慷慨，以及给母亲买车究竟是会让她走向失败还是成功。

sentences.en: Sharon, the church coordinator, heard about the car and understood the impulse.
sentences.zh: 教堂协调员Sharon听说了这辆车，并理解这种冲动。

sentences.en: We all come to care for our mentees and do things to help the family in need, bringing them Thanksgiving dinner or something like that.
sentences.zh: 我们大家都会关心自己的受助学生，并做一些事情来帮助有需要的家庭，比如给他们送感恩节大餐之类的。

sentences.en: Sharon remembered that one mentor, her husband was a dentist, and he fixed a mother's badly decayed teeth for free.
sentences.zh: Sharon记得有一个导师的丈夫是个牙医，他免费为一位母亲严重蛀坏的牙齿做了治疗。

sentences.en: This kind of stuff wasn't part of the Kids Hope USA mission.
sentences.zh: 这类事情并不是美国“希望之星”计划任务的一部分。

sentences.en: Sharon describes it as above and beyond the scope of the program.
sentences.zh: Sharon将其描述为超出了该项目的范畴。

sentences.en: But lots of mentors developed relationships with students and families.
sentences.zh: 但许多导师都与学生和家庭建立了联系。

sentences.en: Lots of them wanted to do more. Betsy DeVos just happens to be a billionaire, and her more is different.
sentences.zh: 他们很多人都想做更多。Betsy DeVos恰好是个亿万富翁，她的“更多”有所不同。

sentences.en: And then Betsy DeVos gave the student another gift, one that shows her generosity and also reveals a lot about her beliefs and assumptions when it comes to educating children.
sentences.zh: 然后，Betsy DeVos送给了这个学生另一份礼物，这份礼物展现了她的慷慨，同时也很大程度上揭示了她在教育儿童方面的信仰和假设。

sentences.en: Burton is a K-5 program, so when the student got to be at sixth grade, she put her and paid for a private school, for her to go into a private school.
sentences.zh: Burton是一所幼儿园到5年级的学校，所以当这个学生上六年级时，她资助她去上一所私立学校。

sentences.en: I couldn't confirm this directly with Betsy DeVos, but five people at Burton and a close friend of Betsy DeVos's said they heard this.
sentences.zh: 我无法直接向Betsy DeVos本人证实这一点，但Burton的五个人以及Betsy DeVos的一位密友都说他们听说了此事。

sentences.en: The way school funding works, when a child leaves a school, the school loses the funding for that child.
sentences.zh: 学校经费的运作方式是，当一个孩子离开学校时，学校就会失去该孩子的经费。

sentences.en: School choice advocates say this encourages competition and innovation.
sentences.zh: 择校倡导者表示，这鼓励了竞争和创新。

sentences.en: Schools have to compete to attract children and the dollars that go with them.
sentences.zh: 学校必须竞争以吸引儿童以及随之而来的资金。

sentences.en: It's the free market applied to education.
sentences.zh: 这就是应用于教育的自由市场。

sentences.en: What makes this complicated is that this money pays not just for that individual child, but for salaries, and programs, and infrastructure, for all the costs of keeping the school open.
sentences.zh: 让事情变得复杂的是，这笔资金不仅支付那个孩子的个人费用，还支付工资、项目、基础设施，以及维持学校运营的所有成本。

sentences.en: Losing that money has ripple effects. And at Burton Elementary, when teachers saw one of the state's most powerful education activists, someone widely seen as anti-public school, pull a child out of the public school system, it did not go over very well with everyone.
sentences.zh: 失去这笔资金会产生连锁反应。在Burton小学，当老师们看到州内最具权力的教育活动家之一——一个被广泛认为反公立学校的人——将一个孩子从公立学校体系中拉出来时，并不是所有人都对此买账。

sentences.en: Again, here's Denise, the teacher. It's super insulting.
sentences.zh: 再次说明，这是老师Denise的看法：这极其具有侮辱性。

sentences.en: It's very insulting. Like, what you do-- all the hard work that you put in-- is not good enough for me, or for people I know, or for people in general.
sentences.zh: 这非常侮辱人。就像是说，你所做的一切——你付出的所有努力——对于我、我认识的人，或者广大民众来说，都是不够好的。

sentences.en: It's just not good enough. And I find it rather ironic that she would tutor a student and then take her out of the school that she was working in.
sentences.zh: 就是不够好。我发现这相当讽刺，她去辅导一个学生，然后却把她从她自己曾工作过的学校里带走。

sentences.en: I thought she wanted to make the school better.
sentences.zh: 我以为她是想让学校变得更好。

sentences.en: She could have used her power way differently.
sentences.zh: 她本可以用完全不同的方式运用她的权力。

sentences.en: Instead of helping fix the school, Betsy DeVos paid to place the child elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 但Betsy DeVos没有去帮忙修缮学校，而是花钱把孩子安置到了别处。

sentences.en: That was her solution. It was like vouchers for one.
sentences.zh: 这就是她的解决办法。这就像是专供个人的代金券。

sentences.en: Megan, the school social worker, says there are lots of things Betsy DeVos could have done.
sentences.zh: 学校社工Megan说，Betsy DeVos本可以做很多事情。

sentences.en: So, I mean, there were so many great things going on at Burton Elementary.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，Burton小学当时有那么多棒极了的事情在发生。

sentences.en: I mean, there really were. We had ESL classes for the parents.
sentences.zh: 我是说，真的有很多。我们为家长开设了ESL英语课程。

sentences.en: We had a parent leadership group that would meet once a month and hear kind of what's going on in the community.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个家长领导小组，每个月开会一次，了解社区里正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And so I really feel like, even talking to the building leadership about trends, or what's keeping our students from reaching those academic milestones that we need them to, and really tapping into the pulse of the school and the community, I feel like there could have been a lot more there.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，哪怕只是和学校领导层讨论趋势，或者是什么在阻碍我们的学生达到我们所期望的学业里程碑，并真正切入学校和社区的脉搏，我觉得本可以有更多深层的作为。

sentences.en: Does this story of what happened at Burton connect to any of the concerns you have about her appointment as Education Secretary?
sentences.zh: 在Burton发生的故事，是否与你对她被任命为教育部长所抱有的任何担忧有关？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think it kind of illustrates that while she may have supported individual children or causes that were in line with her values, I don't think overall she saw the big picture.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我觉得这在某种程度上说明，虽然她可能支持符合她价值观的个别儿童或事业，但我认为她从总体上并没有看到大局。

sentences.en: So while I see there was some great generous acts, it wasn't directly supporting the school building or district.
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然我看到有一些非常慷慨的行为，但它并没有直接支持学校建筑或学区本身。

sentences.en: Helping individual children, but not supporting the school district as a whole.
sentences.zh: 她在帮助个别儿童，但没有支持整个学区。

sentences.en: This is consistent with what Elizabeth Welch, the public school advocate in Grand Rapids, has observed of Betsy DeVos's policy agenda in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 这与大急流城的公立学校倡导者Elizabeth Welch在密歇根州对Betsy DeVos政策议程的观察结果是一致的。

sentences.en: I actually am probably not as cynical as some, in that I believe she probably really does believe the agenda is going to help kids.
sentences.zh: 我其实可能没有某些人那么愤世嫉俗，因为我相信她大概真的相信这个议程会帮助孩子们。

sentences.en: The problem is, as someone for 20 years who has been living here and watching the agenda be implemented, I see it as more about helping that one person.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，作为一个在这里生活了20年并看着这个议程被实施的人，我认为它更多的是关于帮助那一个人。

sentences.en: Take the West Michigan Aviation Academy, which is a charter school founded by the DeVoses.
sentences.zh: 以西密歇根航空学院为例，这是一所由DeVos夫妇创立的特许学校。

sentences.en: They've given more than $4 million to it.
sentences.zh: 他们向该校捐赠了400多万美元。

sentences.en: It's out at the airport, and kids learn how to fly planes, go up in the sky in little Cessnas.
sentences.zh: 它位于机场，孩子们学习如何开飞机，乘坐小型赛斯纳飞机飞上天空。

sentences.en: Wonderful school. I have friends who send their children there.
sentences.zh: 很棒的学校。我有朋友把孩子送到那里去。

sentences.en: Aviation's your background, your kid's kind of a science kid, maybe your kid doesn't fit in well in the structure of traditional public school.
sentences.zh: 如果航空是你的背景，你的孩子有点理科天赋，也许你的孩子不太适合传统公立学校的体制。

sentences.en: It's a great school. However, it's not scalable.
sentences.zh: 这是一所好学校。然而，它无法规模化推广。

sentences.en: It's a great option for those families and those kids, and I don't deny that.
sentences.zh: 对于那些家庭和孩子来说，这是一个绝佳的选择，我并不否认这一点。

sentences.en: But again, I'm looking at the bigger issue of if we create these little microcosms, and then eventually bring vouchers with it, we are still going to be crumbling our infrastructure, which still is going to serve the vast majority of children, because frankly, there's not enough little schools like that to serve the kids.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，我着眼于更宏观的问题：如果我们建立这些微型生态系统，并最终随之引入代金券制度，我们仍然会摧毁我们的基础设施，而基础设施依然要服务于绝大多数儿童，因为坦白讲，没有那么多这样的小学校来服务所有孩子。

sentences.en: The vast majority of children, 85%, that's how many in this country attend traditional public schools.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数儿童，即85%，这个国家有这么多比例的学生就读于传统公立学校。

sentences.en: We will help some kids, but I don't believe we're going to help most kids.
sentences.zh: 我们会帮助一些孩子，但我认为我们不会帮助大多数孩子。

sentences.en: I believe it will actually harm them in the long run.
sentences.zh: 我认为从长远来看，这实际上会伤害他们。

sentences.en: For almost the past 20 years, Betsy DeVos and her husband Dick, maybe more than anyone, have shaped education in Michigan by advocating for policies that increase choice.
sentences.zh: 在过去近20年的时间里，Betsy DeVos和她的丈夫Dick，可能比任何人都更能通过倡导增加选择权的政策来塑造密歇根州的教育。

sentences.en: The results? Both traditional public schools and charter schools are doing worse academically.
sentences.zh: 结果呢？传统公立学校和特许学校的学业表现在下降。

sentences.en: To give one example, in 2003, Michigan fourth graders ranked 28th in the country in reading.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，2003年，密歇根州四年级学生的阅读水平在全国排名第28位。

sentences.en: A decade later, they've fallen to 41st. For all the promises about charter school performance, three quarters of all Michigan charter schools are in the bottom half of all schools as measured by standardized tests.
sentences.zh: 十年后，他们跌至第41位。尽管对特许学校的表现作出了种种承诺，但以标准化测试衡量，四分之三的密歇根特许学校都处于所有学校的后半段。

sentences.en: Public school funding, the money actually available for schools to use, has declined.
sentences.zh: 公立学校的资金，即可供学校实际使用的资金，已经减少。

sentences.en: Segregation has increased. Under Michigan choice policies, white students transfer to districts or charters that are more white, black students go to charters that are more black.
sentences.zh: 隔离现象加剧了。在密歇根州的择校政策下，白人学生转学到白人比例更高的学区或特许学校，黑人学生则去了黑人比例更高的特许学校。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a staggering number of Michigan charters are for profit, 80% according to researchers at Western Michigan University.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，据西密歇根大学的研究人员称，密歇根州数量惊人的特许学校是营利性的，高达80%。

sentences.en: Way more than any other state. I have read that 80% of charter schools in Michigan are run by for-profit entities, and most of them perform below the state average.
sentences.zh: 远超其他任何州。我曾读到过，密歇根州80%的特许学校由营利性实体运营，且其中大多数的表现低于全州平均水平。

sentences.en: At Betsy DeVos's confirmation hearing in January, Senator Sheldon Whitehouse asked her to respond to concerns about her record in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 在1月份Betsy DeVos的听证会上，参议员Sheldon Whitehouse要求她回应有关她在密歇根州记录的担忧。

sentences.en: I will be an advocate for all great schools, no matter their form, their version.
sentences.zh: 我将成为所有优秀学校的倡导者，无论其形式、版本如何。

sentences.en: I will be an advocate for parents being able to make those choices because they're the primary educator for their children.
sentences.zh: 我将成为父母能够做出这些选择的倡导者，因为他们是其子女的第一任教育者。

sentences.en: I get that. But the question is, do you understand that when the parent makes that choice, and the child moves to the charter school, and the funding moves with the child, that leaves a funding gap at the previous school that it can't instantaneously or magically fill, that that is a real problem that respect-- Indeed.
sentences.zh: 我明白这一点。但问题是，你是否明白，当家长做出那个选择，孩子转到特许学校，资金也随之流向该孩子时，这会在之前的学校留下一个无法瞬间或神奇填补的资金缺口，这是一个真实存在的问题，恕我直言——确实如此。

sentences.en: And I mean, I think this is a good example of an issue that is best addressed at the state level.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这是一个很好的例子，说明有些问题最好在州层面解决。

sentences.en: Again, I will-- They went back and forth but this was as much of an answer as she gave.
sentences.zh: 再次声明，我将——他们来来回回辩论，但这就是她给出的最接近答案的回答。

sentences.en: But what public education advocates criticize Betsy DeVos for-- focusing more on the individual than the whole public school system-- DeVos welcomes that criticism.
sentences.zh: 但是，公立学校倡导者批评Betsy DeVos的地方——即把更多精力放在个人身上，而不是整个公立学校体系——DeVos却对这种批评表示欢迎。

sentences.en: It's not a criticism to her. She says that's exactly what she's trying to do.
sentences.zh: 对她而言，这并非批评。她说这正是她一直在尝试做的事情。

sentences.en: This isn't about school systems. This is about individual students, parents, and families.
sentences.zh: 这不是关于学校体系的事。这是关于个别学生、家长和家庭的事。

sentences.en: Betsy DeVos, speaking in July at the ALEC Conference.
sentences.zh: Betsy DeVos 7月在ALEC会议上发表讲话。

sentences.en: ALEC is a national group for conservatives who want to privatize all kinds of government services, including schools.
sentences.zh: ALEC是一个保守派全国组织，旨在将包括学校在内的各种政府服务私有化。

sentences.en: Betsy DeVos is standing behind a lectern in a bright pink skirt suit.
sentences.zh: Betsy DeVos正站在一个亮粉色裙装的讲台后面。

sentences.en: Just the other week, the American Federation for Teachers tweeted at me.
sentences.zh: 就在前几周，美国教师联合会在推特上@了我。

sentences.en: Can you please put it up on the screen? The tweet reads, quote, "Betsy DeVos says public dollars should invest in individual students.
sentences.zh: 能把它投屏到屏幕上吗？这条推文的内容是，引述：“Betsy DeVos说公共资金应该投资于个别学生。

sentences.en: No. We should invest in a system of great public schools for all kids." I couldn't believe it when I read it, but you have to admire their candor.
sentences.zh: 不。我们应该投资于为所有孩子提供优质公立学校的体系。”当我读到它时，我简直不敢相信，但你不得不佩戴他们的坦率。

sentences.en: They've made it clear that they care more about a system, one that was created in the 1800s, than they care about individual students.
sentences.zh: 他们已经明确表示，他们更关心一个在19世纪创建的体制，而不是个别学生。

sentences.en: They are saying education is not an investment in individual students, and they are totally wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们是在说教育不是对个别学生的投资，他们大错特错了。

sentences.en: This isn't just semantics. This is right at the heart of Betsy DeVos's argument.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是文字游戏。这正是Betsy DeVos论点的核心所在。

sentences.en: The way to improve education is to focus on each individual child.
sentences.zh: 改善教育的方法是关注每一个具体的孩子。

sentences.en: She and her backers say the system is broken.
sentences.zh: 她和她的支持者表示，这个系统已经崩溃了。

sentences.en: We've tried to fix it for years, and it hasn't worked.
sentences.zh: 我们多年来一直试图修复它，但没有奏效。

sentences.en: The most vulnerable kids are trapped in the worst schools.
sentences.zh: 最脆弱的孩子被困在最糟糕的学校里。

sentences.en: We have got to address this. We need to try something new.
sentences.zh: 我们必须解决这个问题。我们需要尝试一些新事物。

sentences.en: One of the reasons Betsy DeVos might believe in focusing on the individual student is that she's seen it work herself with some of the students she's helped.
sentences.zh: Betsy DeVos之所以相信关注个别学生，原因之一在于她亲眼看到这种做法在她所帮助过的一些学生身上取得了成效。

sentences.en: Take a moment and picture a child whom you have helped get a great education.
sentences.zh: 花点时间想象一个你曾帮助其获得优质教育的孩子。

sentences.en: For me, I picture Angie, a young girl I've mentored since the first grade who is now entering her senior year in high school.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我想象的是Angie，一个我从一年级起就开始辅导的小女孩，现在她正升入高中最后一年。

sentences.en: My name is Angie. I'm 17 years old. Angie is the second student Betsy DeVos mentored at Burton Elementary.
sentences.zh: 我叫Angie。我17岁了。Angie是Betsy DeVos在Burton小学指导的第二个学生。

sentences.en: I visited her during summer vacation at her house in Grand Rapids.
sentences.zh: 暑假期间，我在她位于大急流城的家中拜访了她。

sentences.en: She'd just gotten home from work, and she was wearing bleached jeans, her hair in a bun.
sentences.zh: 她刚下班回家，穿着漂白水洗过的牛仔裤，头发盘成一个发髻。

sentences.en: She remembers being pulled out of her classroom in first grade and told, you're going to have a mentor.
sentences.zh: 她还记得一年级时自己被叫出教室，并被告知，你将有一位导师。

sentences.en: She was shy around Betsy DeVos. I was shy.
sentences.zh: 她在Betsy DeVos面前很害羞。我很害羞。

sentences.en: Like, she would have to like ask me over and over again to get things out.
sentences.zh: 比如说，她不得不一次又一次地引导我，让我把话吐出来。

sentences.en: And even to this day, I still get kind of shy when I'm around her and talking to her.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，当我在她身边和她交谈时，我还是会觉得有点害羞。

sentences.en: Like, I know I can talk to her about anything, and I know I can trust her for anything, but I still get shy.
sentences.zh: 就像，我知道我可以和她谈论任何事情，我知道我可以在任何事情上信任她，但我依然会害羞。

sentences.en: Betsy DeVos became close to Angie and her family right away.
sentences.zh: Betsy DeVos很快就与Angie及其家人亲近起来。

sentences.en: On Christmas, she came over with presents.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节时，她带着礼物过来了。

sentences.en: She did stuff with them on weekends. First memory, the earliest memory I have a way of that, of doing something like that, is when she took me, my mom, and my oldest sister to a bookstore.
sentences.zh: 周末她会和他们一起做一些事情。最早的记忆，我对此类事情最早的记忆，是她带着我和我妈妈以及大姐去了一家书店。

sentences.en: And she helped my mom get a book so that she can learn English.
sentences.zh: 她帮我妈妈买了一本书，好让妈妈能学习英语。

sentences.en: She let me get-- I don't even know what books I got.
sentences.zh: 她让我买——我甚至不记得我买了什么书。

sentences.en: But she let me and my sisters get books.
sentences.zh: 但她让我和姐姐们买书。

sentences.en: So after that, she would really ask about my mom.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，她真的会经常问起我妈妈的情况。

sentences.en: And then if I ever told her anything, that she would help out my mom, and my mom just really like, looked up to her.
sentences.zh: 如果我跟她提起任何事，她都会帮我妈妈，而我妈妈真的很崇拜她。

sentences.en: Angie's mother grew up in the Dominican Republic and speaks mostly Spanish.
sentences.zh: Angie的母亲在多米尼加共和国长大，主要说西班牙语。

sentences.en: Back then, she was working factory jobs.
sentences.zh: 当时，她在工厂打工。

sentences.en: She was always on the night shift, keeping her away from Angie and her sister.
sentences.zh: 她总是上夜班，这让她无法陪伴Angie和她的姐姐。

sentences.en: She has a chronic illness, and when it flared up, she'd missed work.
sentences.zh: 她患有慢性病，当病情发作时，她就会旷工。

sentences.en: She kept getting fired, so the DeVoses hired her.
sentences.zh: 她一直被解雇，所以DeVos夫妇雇用了她。

sentences.en: Well, she's like the laundry person at all their houses.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她就像他们所有房子的洗衣工。

sentences.en: She's the one that does laundry for them, and that's it.
sentences.zh: 她负责帮他们洗衣服，就是这样。

sentences.en: Basically, she's been doing that ever since.
sentences.zh: 基本上，从那以后她一直都在做这个。

sentences.en: Betsy DeVos's impulse was not to keep Angie and her family at a distance, an hour a week, meet the program requirements, do the minimum.
sentences.zh: Betsy DeVos的冲动并不是与Angie及其家人保持距离，每周一个小时，满足项目要求，做到最低限度。

sentences.en: Her impulse was to invite them into her life.
sentences.zh: 她的冲动是把他们请进自己的生活。

sentences.en: John Booy is a close friend of Betsy DeVos, one of a handful of people she brought to her confirmation hearing.
sentences.zh: John Booy是Betsy DeVos的密友，也是她带去参加确认听证会的少数几个人之一。

sentences.en: He runs the Potter's House, a private Christian school in Grand Rapids that enrolls a lot of low income kids.
sentences.zh: 他在大急流城经营着一所名为“陶工之家”（The Potter's House）的私立基督教学校，该校招收了大量低收入家庭的孩子。

sentences.en: Over the years, Betsy DeVos has mentored students there, and John's seen her help out several families.
sentences.zh: 这些年来，Betsy DeVos一直在那里指导学生，John也看到她帮助了好几个家庭。

sentences.en: Betsy would also involve herself in whatever other ways that they could partner with the family.
sentences.zh: Betsy还会以任何其他他们能与该家庭合作的方式参与其中。

sentences.en: Now, they don't believe in the kind of helping that hurts, or the kind of helping that keeps somebody just dependent on you.
sentences.zh: 如今，他们不相信那种会造成伤害的援助，也不相信那种只会让某人依赖你的援助。

sentences.en: They're very much about work and responsibility.
sentences.zh: 他们非常重视工作和责任。

sentences.en: But it's done in a way that's not patronizing.
sentences.zh: 但这种方式并非居高临下。

sentences.en: It doesn't take your dignity away. It's just walking alongside, and how can, you know, together strategize to meet your goals?
sentences.zh: 它不会剥夺你的尊严。它只是并肩同行，思考如何才能，你知道的，共同制定策略来达成你的目标？

sentences.en: After two years, Betsy DeVos suggested to Angie's mother that Angie transfer out of Burton to the private Christian school that John Booy runs.
sentences.zh: 两年后，Betsy DeVos向Angie的母亲建议，让Angie转学离开Burton，去John Booy经营的那所私立基督教学校。

sentences.en: At first Angie was not on board with the idea.
sentences.zh: 起初Angie并不赞成这个想法。

sentences.en: She didn't want to leave her friends and the school she knew.
sentences.zh: 她不想离开朋友和她熟悉的学校。

sentences.en: Oh, I cried. I remember it was the last day of my second grade, and I had just came home, and they said that I wasn't going back, and I cried.
sentences.zh: 哦，我哭了。我记得那是二年级的最后一天，我刚回到家，他们说我不用回去了，我当时就哭了。

sentences.en: Like, I did not want to switch schools. But when she got to Potter's House, she understood why her mother and Betsy DeVos had wanted her to go there.
sentences.zh: 真的，我不想转学。但当她来到“陶工之家”时，她明白了为什么她的母亲和Betsy DeVos会希望她去那里。

sentences.en: Angie loved reading, and with more attention, she progressed faster.
sentences.zh: Angie酷爱阅读，在获得更多关注后，她的进步更快了。

sentences.en: The work was more challenging. You had to want to do well.
sentences.zh: 功课更具挑战性了。你必须有一颗想要做好的心。

sentences.en: Betsy DeVos continued to mentor Angie. When she got to middle school, sometimes Betsy DeVos would take her out at lunchtime.
sentences.zh: Betsy DeVos继续指导Angie。当她上初中时，有时候Betsy DeVos会在午休时带她出去。

sentences.en: A few times, we went to Biggby's downtown to get hot chocolate.
sentences.zh: 有几次，我们去了市中心的Biggby买热巧克力。

sentences.en: So that was fun. It was nice. She always has nice cars.
sentences.zh: 所以这很有趣。感觉很好。她总是开好车。

sentences.en: That was just like-- I was always like amazed, because it was always a different car, or sometimes even a driver.
sentences.zh: 那感觉就像——我总是感到惊叹，因为总是不同的车，有时甚至还有司机。

sentences.en: As Angie got older, Betsy DeVos helped her choose a high school to go to, suggested tours of three different schools.
sentences.zh: 随着Angie逐渐长大，Betsy DeVos帮她选择了一所要上的高中，并建议参观三所不同的学校。

sentences.en: None are traditional public schools. She ended up at a private Christian high school, which she loves.
sentences.zh: 没有一所是传统公立学校。她最终进入了一所私立基督教高中，她非常喜欢那里。

sentences.en: Betsy DeVos pays part of her tuition and her mother pays the other part.
sentences.zh: Betsy DeVos支付她一部分学费，她母亲支付另一部分。

sentences.en: This summer, Angie's working with her mother for the DeVos family.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天，Angie和母亲一起为DeVos家族工作。

sentences.en: Oh, I'm cleaning.
sentences.zh: 哦，我在打扫卫生。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's all I do every summer since eighth grade.
sentences.zh: 对，这就是我自八年级以来每个夏天都在做的事情。

sentences.en: Clean. She likes working, making her own money.
sentences.zh: 打扫。她喜欢工作，赚自己的钱。

sentences.en: She vacuums, mops, smaller stuff too. We're house detailers.
sentences.zh: 她吸尘、拖地，也做一些小活。我们是房屋细节清理工。

sentences.en: We make sure everything looks nice and good, and there's no dust anywhere, that the beds are like, fixed up pretty, that the bathrooms, everything like that.
sentences.zh: 我们确保每样东西看起来都整洁漂亮，没有任何灰尘，床铺得整整齐齐，浴室以及诸如此类的一切都井井有条。

sentences.en: Anything you do in a house, that's what we do.
sentences.zh: 你在房子里干的任何活，这就是我们干的。

sentences.en: One of the other kids the DeVos's mentored works with them.
sentences.zh: DeVos夫妇指导过的另一个孩子也和他们一起工作。

sentences.en: He lives in the neighborhood, and they give him rides home.
sentences.zh: 他住在附近，他们顺便载他回家。

sentences.en: They're down at the family's summer compound in Holland most days, a lake shore estate with a mansion filled with delicate objects.
sentences.zh: 他们大部分时间都在霍兰德（Holland）的家族夏季大院里，那是一个湖滨庄园，里面有一座摆满精致物品的豪宅。

sentences.en: Everything has to be a certain way in a certain position.
sentences.zh: 每样东西都必须以特定的方式放在特定的位置。

sentences.en: So we take pictures of everything, so that if we ever have to move something, we know exactly how it goes, like exactly how it goes.
sentences.zh: 所以我们给每样东西都拍照，这样如果我们不得不移动任何东西，我们就确切地知道它是怎么摆的，就像原来一模一样。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: Wanda, Angie's mother, is out on the porch, giving Angie privacy while also remaining near.
sentences.zh: Angie的母亲Wanda正坐在门廊上，既给Angie留出私人空间，又离得不远。

sentences.en: She comes inside to talk. How would your life and Angie's life be different if you hadn't met Betsy?
sentences.zh: 她走进来谈话。如果你没有遇到Betsy，你和Angie的生活会有什么不同？

sentences.en: Basically, it's like, a very private, kind of very sentimental thing.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这就像是一件非常私密、非常感人的事情。

sentences.en: But she feels like Miss Betsy is someone who after God, she feels like God actually put her in our lives at the perfect moment, because she just came in when things were just very wrong and very bad for our lives.
sentences.zh: 但她觉得Betsy女士是这样一个人，在上帝之后，她觉得上帝实际上是在最完美的时刻把她带入了我们的生活，因为当我们的生活处于非常错误、非常糟糕的境地时，她偏偏就走进了我们的生活。

sentences.en: As Wanda says this, she cups a hand over her heart.
sentences.zh: Wanda一边说着，一边用手捧着心口。

sentences.en: But she's very grateful for Miss Betsy and everything she's done, because she's somebody who, without even asking for anything in return, gave my mom a hand and has just been there to help us with whatever it is that we need every step of the way.
sentences.zh: 不过她真的很感激Betsy DeVos女士以及她所做的一切，因为她是不求任何回报、向我妈妈伸出援手的人，而且每一步都在我们需要的时候给予帮助。

sentences.en: Angie doesn't totally follow the news, doesn't totally trust it.
sentences.zh: Angie并不是完全关注新闻，也不是完全信任新闻。

sentences.en: But for while, she was seeing things online about Betsy DeVos that upset her.
sentences.zh: 但有一段时间，她在网上看到了一些关于Betsy DeVos的负面消息，这让她很难过。

sentences.en: It would just make me feel like, really, like, bad in a way.
sentences.zh: 这会让我觉得，真的，从某种程度上说，感觉很糟糕。

sentences.en: Because it's not how things actually are.
sentences.zh: 因为这并不是实际情况。

sentences.en: I know the actual truth. Like, I have a really close relationship with her, so I know how things actually are.
sentences.zh: 我知道真实的真相。比如说，我和她关系非常密切，所以我知道实际情况到底是怎样的。

sentences.en: And it's just-- it's whatever. I mean, everybody's gonna think what they want to think.
sentences.zh: 这就算了吧——无所谓。我的意思是，每个人都会有他们自己的想法。

sentences.en: Angie's quick to say that Betsy DeVos is good for this job, because she's passionate about education and helping kids, all kids, and making it easier for kids to choose.
sentences.zh: Angie很快就指出Betsy DeVos很适合这份工作，因为她对教育和帮助孩子们（所有的孩子）充满热情，并且让孩子们更容易做出选择。

sentences.en: But when I ask her what Betsy DeVos should do in this job, she doesn't pretend to have studied up on policy.
sentences.zh: 但当我问她Betsy DeVos在这份工作上应该做些什么时，她并没有假装自己研究过政策。

sentences.en: Then a moment later, she suggests something.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，她提出了一个建议。

sentences.en: OK. Something I think she should hopefully at least like look into is making public schools better.
sentences.zh: 好吧。我认为她至少应该考虑的一件事是把公立学校办得更好。

sentences.en: Because public schools, they're not bad.
sentences.zh: 因为公立学校并不是不好。

sentences.en: But like, there's just some public schools that just like, the teachers don't really care to help our students and stuff like that, and they just want to give the students an A.
sentences.zh: 但是，有些公立学校的老师其实并不怎么关心如何去帮助学生之类的事情，他们只是想给学生打个A。

sentences.en: So I feel like if she would look more into public schools, and just making them better for any kind of student no matter where, then that would be a good thing.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，如果她能更多地关注公立学校，不管在什么地方，都能为各种类型的学生把学校办得更好，那将是一件好事。

sentences.en: Of course, that's basically the job description of the Secretary of Education, to oversee the country's public schools and make them better for any kind of student.
sentences.zh: 当然，这基本上就是教育部长的职责描述，即监督国家的公立学校，并为各种类型的学生把学校办得更好。

sentences.en: And what's so different about Betsy DeVos is that she doesn't care whether schools are public or not.
sentences.zh: 而Betsy DeVos与众不同的一点在于，她并不在乎学校是否是公立的。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter what word comes before school, she likes to say-- public, private, charter, home, virtual, magnet, parochial.
sentences.zh: 学校前面带什么词并不重要，她总是喜欢这样说——公立的、私立的、特许的、在家上学的、虚拟的、磁吸的、教会学校。

sentences.en: That's a radically different way to see this job.
sentences.zh: 这是看待这份工作的一种截然不同的方式。

sentences.en: But seeing what she did in Michigan, not a huge surprise.
sentences.zh: 但看到她在密歇根州所做的事情，这也就不足为奇了。

sentences.en: Susan Burton, who's one of the producers of our program.
sentences.zh: Susan Burton，我们节目的制作人之一。

sentences.en: Coming up, rumors about cartoon characters coming alive in real life.
sentences.zh: 接下来，关于卡通人物在现实生活中复活的传闻。

sentences.en: That's in a minute from Chicago Public Radio, when our program continues.
sentences.zh: 节目稍后继续，由芝加哥公共广播电台为您播出。

sentences.en: It's This American Life. I'm Ira Glass. Today's program, Private Geography, stories of the places that we're from and how those places make us.
sentences.zh: 这里是《This American Life》。我是Ira Glass。今天的节目是《Private Geography》，讲述我们来自何方以及这些地方如何塑造了我们。

sentences.en: We've arrived at Act Two of our program, Act Two, Kids in the Hall.
sentences.zh: 我们来到了节目的第二幕，第二幕是“礼拜堂里的小孩”。

sentences.en: And by hall in this case, I mean the Kingdom Hall.
sentences.zh: 在这个语境下，hall指的是王国聚会所。

sentences.en: Your cultural identity, somebody once said, is not a suitcase you can lose at the airport.
sentences.zh: 有人曾说过，你的文化认同不是一个会在机场弄丢的手提箱。

sentences.en: And that's true even if you're trying to lose it.
sentences.zh: 即使你正试图摆脱它，这也是事实。

sentences.en: One of our producers, Neil Drumming, discovered that truth recently, when he read an email that somebody sent to the radio show.
sentences.zh: 我们的制作人之一Neil Drumming最近读到了一封听众发给电台的邮件，发现了这个事实。

sentences.en: I was raised as a Jehovah's Witness until the age of 17, when I left the faith of my own volition.
sentences.zh: 我从小作为耶和华见证人长大，直到17岁时我自愿离开了这个信仰。

sentences.en: There are roughly 1 million Jehovah's Witnesses spread across the United States, few enough that every time I come across a former one, an ex-JW, I can't help but feel like it's an opportunity to share some rare communal experience.
sentences.zh: 全美大约有100万名耶和华见证人，人数很少，以至于每次我遇到前成员（前JW）时，都会忍不住觉得这是一个分享某种稀有共同经历的机会。

sentences.en: Like, what happened to you, or what made you leave?
sentences.zh: 比如，你身上发生了什么，或者是什么让你决定离开？

sentences.en: That's why when I read the email that Will McMillian sent to This American Life, I immediately wanted to talk to him, though his experience was different from mine, in that he was once a Witness and also gay.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么当我读到Will McMillian发给《This American Life》的邮件时，我立刻就想和他聊聊，尽管他的经历和我不一样，他曾经是见证人，而且也是个同性恋。

sentences.en: Do you remember what the Jehovah's Witness Bible says about homosexuality?
sentences.zh: 你还记得耶和华见证人的圣经对同性恋是怎么说的吗？

sentences.en: Like from the Scriptures? Yeah. I remember there's a-- I apologize for not being more-- like, a better memory on this, but I actually gave a talk about homosexuality once.
sentences.zh: 比如从经文来看？记得。我记得有一段——很抱歉我记性不是太好，但我其实曾经做过一次关于同性恋的演讲。

sentences.en: That's Will. And when he says he gave a talk, he's referring to these speeches Jehovah's Witnesses are required to regularly give each other based on Scripture during services at the Kingdom Hall, which is what they call their house of worship.
sentences.zh: 那是Will。当他说他做过演讲时，他指的是耶和华见证人在王国聚会所（他们对礼拜堂的称呼）做礼拜期间，被要求定期根据圣经互相发表的那些演讲。

sentences.en: In his email to the show, Will said that he'd been a practicing witness since he was a teenager.
sentences.zh: 在给节目的邮件中，Will说他从十几岁起就是一个虔诚的见证人。

sentences.en: He's 37 now. He also wrote that since he was about 10, he knew he was gay.
sentences.zh: 他现在37岁了。他还写道，从他大约10岁起，他就知道自己是同性恋。

sentences.en: He kept that fact a secret for 20 years because Jehovah's Witnesses believe that sometime in the near future, when Jehovah God cleanses the earth and remakes it into the paradise that it once was, those who have not faithfully obeyed his word will be destroyed.
sentences.zh: 他把这个事实保守了20年，因为耶和华见证人相信，在不久的将来，当耶和华上帝洁净地球并将其重新创造为昔日的乐园时，那些没有忠实顺从他话语的人将被毁灭。

sentences.en: And there's a scripture that talks about some of you were thieves, some of you were murderers, some of you were tax evaders, and some of you were men who lied with men.
sentences.zh: 有一段经文提到，你们当中有些人曾是小偷，有些人曾是谋杀犯，有些人曾是逃税者，还有些人曾是与男人苟合的男人。

sentences.en: Kind of this laundry list of, these are sins that will get you killed.
sentences.zh: 就像是一长串清单，列举了这些会让你丧命的罪过。

sentences.en: OK. You know where this is going. In his early 30's, Will's homosexuality was uncovered, and he was kicked out of the religion.
sentences.zh: 好吧。你知道接下来会发生什么。在Will三十岁出头时，他的同性恋身份被发现了，他被逐出了这个宗教。

sentences.en: Witnesses call it being disfellowshipped.
sentences.zh: 见证人称之为“开除”。

sentences.en: Will wrote in his email to us that at the time he got the boot, he felt like his life had come to an end.
sentences.zh: Will在给我们发来的邮件中写道，在他被赶出门的那一刻，他觉得自己的生命已经走到了尽头。

sentences.en: But as he and I emailed back and forth, the thing that really struck me about him was how torn he still seemed to be.
sentences.zh: 但随着我和他来来回回地发邮件，他最让我印象深刻的是，他似乎依然感到无比纠结。

sentences.en: Here he was, finally happily living as a gay man a half dozen years later.
sentences.zh: 六年后的今天，他终于过上了快乐的同性恋生活。

sentences.en: And yet even now, Will doesn't smoke, he doesn't do drugs, he won't accept a blood transfusion, all things that Jehovah's Witnesses say the Bible forbids.
sentences.zh: 然而即使到现在，Will不抽烟，不吸毒，不接受输血，而这些都是耶和华见证人称圣经所禁止的事情。

sentences.en: He's still clinging to the dictates of a religion that forced him to deny his identity for two decades.
sentences.zh: 他依然死死抓住一个曾强迫他掩盖身份长达二十年的宗教的戒律不放。

sentences.en: "My spiritual beliefs remained the same after I was disfellowshipped and after I came out," he wrote.
sentences.zh: “在我被开除之后，以及在我出柜之后，我的精神信仰依然保持不变，”他写道。

sentences.en: "You want to accept yourself for who you are while at the same time condemning yourself for it." Will wrote that when he's around other openly gay men, he feels like he has to hide his spiritual beliefs from them, like some sort of closeted disciple.
sentences.zh: “你一方面想要接纳真实的自己，另一方面却又因此而谴责自己。”Will写道，当他和其他公开的同性恋者在一起时，他觉得自己必须向他们隐瞒自己的精神信仰，就像某种藏在衣橱里的信徒一样。

sentences.en: And when he sees great tragedy in the world, like an earthquake, a school shooting, or a hate-filled attack on an Orlando nightclub, his mind goes immediately to prophecy that was drilled into him from an early age.
sentences.zh: 当他看到世上的巨大悲剧时，比如地震、校园枪击案，或者对奥兰多夜总会的仇恨袭击，他的脑海里就会立刻浮现出从小就被灌输的预言。

sentences.en: Quote, "I am seeing the signs. I need to be close to Jehovah.
sentences.zh: 引述一下，“我看到了这些迹象。我需要亲近耶和华。

sentences.en: I need to stop being a pawn of Satan with my debauched life.
sentences.zh: 我不能再用我荒淫的生活做撒旦的棋子了。

sentences.en: I need to save myself from eternal destruction." All the stuff he used to believe.
sentences.zh: 我需要拯救自己免于永恒的毁灭。”所有这些他曾经深信不疑的东西。

sentences.en: I really believed it. I really believed what I was being taught, or what I was trying to teach other people.
sentences.zh: 我真的相信过。我真的相信我被教导的东西，或者我试图教导别人的东西。

sentences.en: I really did believe that we're in the last days of this system of things, and I can watch and see rainforests get destroyed, or I can see politicians come in to office and do terrible things to people and think, it's OK, because Jehovah will take care of it, and all these things that are going wrong are only temporary.
sentences.zh: 我真的相信我们正处于这个事物制度的最后日子，我可以看着雨林被毁，或者我可以看着政客上台对人们做可怕的事情，然后心想，没关系，因为耶和华会照顾这一切，所有这些出错的事情都只是暂时的。

sentences.en: The last days, this system of things, Satan and his demons.
sentences.zh: 最后的日子，这个事物制度，撒旦和他的恶魔们。

sentences.en: It was both freaky and familiar to hear Will using all this ominous terminology I'd grown up with, but almost completely forgotten.
sentences.zh: 听到Will使用所有这些我从小听过但几乎已经快忘光的阴森术语，既诡异又熟悉。

sentences.en: When I read his emails, I knew that I wanted to talk to Will, but I wasn't exactly sure why until it happened.
sentences.zh: 当我读他的邮件时，我知道我想和Will聊聊，但我并不是很清楚原因，直到我们真正聊了起来。

sentences.en: It just felt familiar. I wanted to revisit that.
sentences.zh: 就是觉得很熟悉。我想重新审视那种感觉。

sentences.en: When you're a witness-- and maybe you'll remember this-- when you're told that anything supernatural is demonic, you kind of shut those things down.
sentences.zh: 当你是见证人时——也许你还记得——当你被告知任何超自然的东西都是恶魔作祟时，你就会把那些东西屏蔽掉。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah. At least I did. I shut those things down.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。至少我是这样的。我把那些东西都屏蔽了。

sentences.en: Yeah. And I really loved fantasy novels.
sentences.zh: 对。而且我真的很喜欢奇幻小说。

sentences.en: And I felt that I couldn't read them. Yeah, right?
sentences.zh: 我觉得我不能读它们。对吧？

sentences.en: Like, I felt like I shouldn't be reading them.
sentences.zh: 就像，我觉得我不应该去读它们一样。

sentences.en: Exactly. Yeah, and I loved science fiction, and there was a period of time where I was writing a lot of science fiction, and I was like, kind of doing it secretively.
sentences.zh: 没错。对，而且我很喜欢科幻小说，有一段时间我写了很多科幻小说，而且我有点像是偷偷摸摸地在写。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, when I was a kid, there was a rumor in the Hall.
sentences.zh: 对，你知道的，当我还是个孩子的时候，聚会所里流传着一个传言。

sentences.en: This is crazy. The Smurf rumor? The Smurf rumor.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。蓝精灵的传言？蓝精灵的传言。

sentences.en: No, you heard the Smurf rumor? OK. Tell it to me the way you heard it.
sentences.zh: 不，你听说过蓝精灵的传言？好吧。把你是怎么听说的讲给我听听。

sentences.en: I want to hear this. Oh, my gosh. As soon as you said you heard a rumor, I'm like, is it the Smurf rumor?
sentences.zh: 我想听听这个。哦，天哪。你一说你听说过一个传言，我就想，难道是蓝精灵的传言吗？

sentences.en: Yes, the Smurf rumor, for everybody who doesn't know the Smurf rumor, apparently a sister came to the congregation with one of her children who had a Smurf doll, and during the meeting the Smurf doll came to life, and started running back and forth through the aisles saying, you, you, God, Jehovah, back and forth through the Kingdom Hall.
sentences.zh: 是的，蓝精灵的传言，对于那些不知道蓝精灵传言的人来说，据说有个姐妹带着她的一个孩子去聚会，孩子带了一个蓝精灵玩偶，在开会期间，蓝精灵玩偶居然活了过来，开始在过道里跑来跑去，嘴里喊着“你，你，神，耶和华”，在王国聚会所里跑来跑去。

sentences.en: Is that your version of it? I feel like I'm about to cry.
sentences.zh: 那是你听的版本吗？我觉得我快哭了。

sentences.en: I've never heard this corroborated. You have more detail.
sentences.zh: 我从来没听说过这个传言得到证实。你了解得更详细。

sentences.en: The way I heard it was, a kid came to the Kingdom Hall with a Smurf in their back pocket, and it jumped out and ran out.
sentences.zh: 我听到的版本是，有个小孩带着一个蓝精灵去王国聚会所，把它放在后裤兜里，结果它跳出来跑掉了。

sentences.en: But it's essentially the same idea, is that the mythology around the Smurfs were so demonic that they were, I don't know, somehow associated with Satan.
sentences.zh: 但基本上意思都一样，就是关于蓝精灵的神话色彩太重了，以至于它们，我不知道，某种程度上和撒旦联系在了一起。

sentences.en: Repressed nerdiness is about where the similarities between Will and I end.
sentences.zh: 压抑的书呆子气，大概就是我和Will之间仅有的相似之处了。

sentences.en: I grew up in Queens. He's from the Pacific Northwest.
sentences.zh: 我在皇后区长大。他来自太平洋西北地区。

sentences.en: I'm black. He's white. I'm straight. He's gay.
sentences.zh: 我是黑人。他是白人。我是直的。他是弯的。

sentences.en: And my mother raised me in the Truth, which is how Jehovah's Witnesses colloquially refer to their faith.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈是在“真理”中把我抚养长大的，这是耶和华见证人对他们信仰的俗称。

sentences.en: No one in Will's immediate family was a practicing witness.
sentences.zh: Will的直系亲属中没有人是虔诚的见证人。

sentences.en: He found the Truth and chose it for himself, although family has a lot to do with why he did.
sentences.zh: 他是自己发现了“真理”并选择了它，尽管家庭在其中扮演了很大的原因。

sentences.en: I had a very physically violent father.
sentences.zh: 我有一个有严重暴力倾向的父亲。

sentences.en: Everything that I felt like I did or that I was interested, my dad hated.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我做的每一件事，或者我感兴趣的每一样东西，我爸爸都讨厌。

sentences.en: Like, you could tell if somebody is enjoying being unkind to you.
sentences.zh: 就像，你能看出一个人是否在享受对你不友好。

sentences.en: If I wanted to go outside, he'd say no, you can't go outside, and would say with a smile on his face.
sentences.zh: 如果我想出门，他会说不行，你不能出门，而且脸上还挂着微笑。

sentences.en: When Will was about 11 years old, his family moved into a new place, and he met the Planks.
sentences.zh: Will大约11岁时，他的家人搬到了一个新地方，他遇到了Plank一家。

sentences.en: The Planks were a neighboring family of Jehovah's Witnesses, a mom, a dad, and two daughters.
sentences.zh: Plank一家是邻居，也是耶和华见证人，包括爸爸、妈妈和两个女儿。

sentences.en: As soon as he started going over to their house, Will notice something different about them.
sentences.zh: 一去他们家串门，Will就发现他们有些不一样。

sentences.en: Oh, these are people who are nice, and they really seem to love each other, and they really seem to be close to each other.
sentences.zh: 哦，这些人真好，他们看起来真的很爱彼此，而且看起来关系非常亲密。

sentences.en: And so it was just a complete diametric opposite of what I was experiencing right next door in my own home.
sentences.zh: 这和我隔壁自己家里经历的一切完全是截然相反的两个极端。

sentences.en: I felt that I could kind of be a little more silly, that I could be a little more calm.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己可以稍微变得更孩子气一点，可以稍微变得更平静一点。

sentences.en: And I associated how they behaved with them being Jehovah's Witnesses, because they would always say things like, Jehovah provides, or we do these things and Jehovah blessed us.
sentences.zh: 我把他们的行为举止和他们是耶和华见证人联系在了一起，因为他们总是说类似“耶和华自有安排”或者“我们做了这些事，耶和华保佑了我们”这样的话。

sentences.en: And so it was really like, oh, so there's a reason why you're like this.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的就像是，哦，原来这就是你们为什么会这样的原因。

sentences.en: So Will began studying with the Planks, learning Scripture and lessons from the parents right alongside their daughters.
sentences.zh: 于是Will开始和Plank一家一起学习，和他们的女儿们一起向这对父母学习经文和课程。

sentences.en: He did so in secret. He didn't tell his family that he was becoming a Jehovah's Witness.
sentences.zh: 他是秘密进行的。他没有告诉家人自己正在成为一名耶和华见证人。

sentences.en: It was his escape. It was almost like a form of a very kind of sweet rebellion in a way, where it's like having a clubhouse that nobody has access to but me.
sentences.zh: 这是他的避难所。这几乎就像是一种非常甜蜜的叛逆，就好像拥有一个只有我能进出的俱乐部会所一样。

sentences.en: At the Planks's and eventually at the Kingdom Hall, Will found kindness, acceptance, and engagement amongst the brothers and sisters there.
sentences.zh: 在Plank家里，后来在王国聚会所里，Will在那里的弟兄姐妹身上感受到了善良、接纳和关怀。

sentences.en: And for him, there was a special added bonus.
sentences.zh: 对她来说，还有一个额外的特殊好处。

sentences.en: When I realized that I was gay, I saw it as an imperfection in myself, like if I thought that I was a kleptomaniac.
sentences.zh: 当我意识到自己是同性恋时，我把它看作是我身上的一种缺陷，就像我觉得自己是个性倒错者一样。

sentences.en: Like, OK, jeez, I've got this huge thing about myself that I need to figure out how to control, and I need to learn how to hate.
sentences.zh: 就像是，好吧，天哪，我身上有这么大一个问题，我得想办法控制它，我得学会去恨它。

sentences.en: And so being a Witness was to me like the most strict form of control that I could do.
sentences.zh: 所以做见证人对我来说就像是我能采取的最严格的控制形式。

sentences.en: Exercising that control wasn't easy for Will.
sentences.zh: 对Will来说，行使这种控制并不容易。

sentences.en: The Bible says plenty about temptation, none of which I can specifically remember, the upshot of which is that temptation is everywhere.
sentences.zh: 圣经里有很多关于诱惑的论述，具体内容我记不太清了，但核心结论就是诱惑无处不在。

sentences.en: I loved the show Will and Grace, but I'm like, I cannot watch this show because Satan is watching me.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢《威尔和格蕾丝》这部剧，但我想：我不能看这个剧，因为撒旦在看着我呢。

sentences.en: Did you have crushes within the Kingdom Hall?
sentences.zh: 你在王国聚会所里有过暗恋对象吗？

sentences.en: Are you kidding? It's a lot of men in suits.
sentences.zh: 开什么玩笑？那里有好多穿西装的男人。

sentences.en: There's a lot of suits, yeah, and that are good speakers.
sentences.zh: 确实有很多穿西装的，而且都很会演讲。

sentences.en: I loved to give talks. I loved to write talks.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢做演讲。我喜欢写演讲稿。

sentences.en: It was smooth. I was very, very good. And it came very easily for me to do.
sentences.zh: 一切都很顺利。我做得非常非常好。而且对老说这轻而易举。

sentences.en: And so when I would have a brother compliment me, getting male praise was kind of intoxicating.
sentences.zh: 所以当有弟兄称赞我时，得到男性的赞美简直让人陶醉。

sentences.en: And it was-- I would say like, when I got baptized when I was 23 was really when I really began to feel sort of my depression because I was really trying to do more and more in the congregation to suppress that feeling of being gay.
sentences.zh: 而且——我可以说，当我23岁受洗时，才真正开始感到某种抑郁，因为我真的试图在会众里做越来越多事，来压抑那种身为同性恋的感觉。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, there were would be brothers that I would have crushes on, and they'd be married.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，会有一些我暗恋的弟兄，而他们已经结婚了。

sentences.en: I would be developing these relationships, these friendships, with these brothers, and I would start to get feelings for, and would we get irritated because I can't do anything about this.
sentences.zh: 我会和这些弟兄建立这种关系、这种友谊，然后我会开始对他们产生感情，接着我会感到恼火，因为我对此无能为力。

sentences.en: I found myself getting more and more needy around these brothers because I would want to like, so do you want to come over hang out?
sentences.zh: 我发现自己在这些弟兄面前变得越来越黏人，因为我会想，呃，你想要过来一起玩吗？

sentences.en: Do you want to go do something? Do you want to go for a hike?
sentences.zh: 你想出去做点什么吗？你想去远足吗？

sentences.en: Do you want to go do this? And they'd be like, let me check with my wife.
sentences.zh: 你想去干这个吗？而他们会说，我得先问问我老婆。

sentences.en: And I would just be like, ugh, fine. Will persisted for years fighting his natural inclinations and growing more and more active in the truth.
sentences.zh: 然后我就会想，呃，好吧。Will多年来一直在压抑自己的天性，并在真理中变得越来越活跃。

sentences.en: By the time he was 30, he was what witnesses call a full-time pioneer, putting in 70 hours worth of street preaching and evangelical work per month, living with a cousin and her family who were Jehovah's Witnesses.
sentences.zh: 到他30岁时，他成了见证人所说的全职先驱，每个月要花70个小时在街头传道和宣教，跟他的表姐及信奉耶和华见证人的家人住在一起。

sentences.en: And I was in my 30's and now a virgin still, and your sexuality doesn't really go anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我当时三十多岁，而且依然是个处男，但你的性取向并不会真的凭空消失。

sentences.en: To be blunt, I needed an outlet. And I knew I wasn't interested in girls.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我需要一个宣泄口。而且我知道我对女孩不感兴趣。

sentences.en: And so I would go to gay websites, graphic gay websites.
sentences.zh: 所以我会去浏览同性恋网站，大尺度的同性恋网站。

sentences.en: When you would visit those websites, that is appealing to a thing that is intrinsically you.
sentences.zh: 当你浏览这些网站时，它在呼唤着你骨子里的本能。

sentences.en: So was there any relief to actually acknowledging yourself, to like acknowledging who you were?
sentences.zh: 那么，真正正视自己，承认自己是谁，会有所解脱吗？

sentences.en: Was that-- did you get even like, a small amount of like satisfaction from that?
sentences.zh: 那是——你甚至能从中获得哪怕是一点点的满足感吗？

sentences.en: No. I felt nothing but guilt. Will was out picking up Chinese food for the rest of the family when they discovered his browser history.
sentences.zh: 没有。我感到的只有负罪感。Will当时正出去为家里的其他人买中餐，结果他们发现了他的浏览器历史记录。

sentences.en: The cousin's eldest son, a college student, was trying to figure out why internet service was slow in the house that night.
sentences.zh: 表姐的大儿子是个大学生，当时正在纳闷为什么那天晚上的家里网速那么慢。

sentences.en: He thought maybe Will had left his laptop downloading some big file or another.
sentences.zh: 他以为是Will把笔记本电脑留着下载什么大文件了。

sentences.en: When Will got back with dinner, the husband confronted him at the door.
sentences.zh: 当Will带着晚餐回来时，表姐夫在门口堵住了他。

sentences.en: It was like having my skin ripped off of me at that moment.
sentences.zh: 那一刻就像是活生生把我的皮给剥了下来。

sentences.en: And I just started lying. Wow. What did you say?
sentences.zh: 我开始撒谎。哇。你说了什么？

sentences.en: I was like, you know what? My computer has malware on it, and it keeps bringing up all these pornography websites.
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道吗？我的电脑中毒了，它总是弹出所有这些色情网站。

sentences.en: And I keep trying to minimize it and get rid of it, but it's not me.
sentences.zh: 我一直在试图把它最小化并删掉，但那不是我。

sentences.en: And I kept saying like, you know me. You know I wouldn't do this.
sentences.zh: 我一直说，你知道我的为人。你知道我不会做这种事的。

sentences.en: This is a huge mistake. And so he like, pulled open my laptop and was like, well, this isn't just something from a few weeks or a few months.
sentences.zh: 这是一个天大的误会。于是他一把拉开我的笔记本电脑说，这可不仅仅是几个星期或几个月前的东西。

sentences.en: He goes, this goes back years. There's no defiance there.
sentences.zh: 他说，这可以追溯到好几年前。毫无反抗的余地。

sentences.en: There's no anger. No. Yeah, and that like-- you know, I'm projecting because I'm listening to this story, and I'm angry.
sentences.zh: 也没有愤怒。没有。对，而且那——你知道的，我在代入，因为我在听这个故事，我很生气。

sentences.en: I feel angry for you. You know, I'm just like, the whole notion that you would say like, you know me, I wouldn't do this.
sentences.zh: 我为你感到生气。你知道，我只是觉得，你居然会说“你知道我，我不会做这种事”这种想法。

sentences.en: It's like, he doesn't know you at all. The husband told him to pack up his things and drove him to a hotel.
sentences.zh: 这就好像，他根本一点也不了解你。表姐夫让他收拾好东西，开车把他送到了酒店。

sentences.en: News of Will's transgression soon spread through the Kingdom Hall.
sentences.zh: Will违规的消息很快在王国聚会所里传开了。

sentences.en: He was brought before a judicial committee of congregation elders.
sentences.zh: 他被带到由会众长老组成的司法委员会面前。

sentences.en: They said a prayer. And they said, so tell us why you're here?
sentences.zh: 他们做了一个祷告。然后他们说，那么，告诉我们你为什么来这里？

sentences.en: Tell us tell us what you've done. And once I made the confession, one of the brothers pulled out this piece of paper, and there was a bunch of questions.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们，告诉我们你都做了什么。一旦我坦白了，其中一个弟兄掏出一张纸，上面有一堆问题。

sentences.en: But the first question was, are you attracted to minors?
sentences.zh: 但第一个问题是，你对未成年人有吸引力吗？

sentences.en: Have you ever had sex with a minor? Are you attracted to animals?
sentences.zh: 你跟未成年人发生过性关系吗？你对动物有吸引力吗？

sentences.en: Have you ever engaged in bestiality? Those are the first questions they asked you?
sentences.zh: 你跟动物发生过性行为吗？那是他们问你的第一批问题？

sentences.en: First four questions that they asked me.
sentences.zh: 他们问我的前四个问题。

sentences.en: He was stripped of his privileges within the Kingdom Hall and essentially put on probation, where he could attend meetings in silence, but little else.
sentences.zh: 他被剥夺了在王国聚会所里的特权，基本上处于留用察看的状态，可以在沉默中参加聚会，但别的什么也做不了。

sentences.en: On top of that, he was informed that no matter what happened, he would never be allowed to be alone with children in the congregation ever again.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他被告知无论发生什么，以后在会众里都绝对不能再单独和孩子们在一起了。

sentences.en: Will quietly accept this reprobation without resistance.
sentences.zh: Will默默地接受了这种申斥，没有反抗。

sentences.en: The next phase in Will's life began the way so many new beginnings do these days, with the dating app OKCupid.
sentences.zh: Will人生的下一阶段像如今许多新的开始一样，从约会软件OKCupid开始了。

sentences.en: Instead of starting back to the Hall immediately, Will decided he needed some time to himself and moved in with a friend of his, a non-Witness.
sentences.zh: Will决定先不急着回聚会所，而是需要一些时间独处，于是搬去和一个不是见证人的朋友同住。

sentences.en: She had just opened up her own OKCupid profile.
sentences.zh: 她刚刚注册了自己的OKCupid账号。

sentences.en: And she was like you should make one too.
sentences.zh: 她说你也应该做一个。

sentences.en: And I was like, OK. And so I made one, and I made it like, man seeking woman, just to see what would happen.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧。于是我就注册了一个，设置成男寻找女，只想看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: That alone was something I shouldn't have been doing, because if you're a brother, you only date sisters.
sentences.zh: 光是这一举动就是我不该做的，因为如果你是一个弟兄，你只能和姐妹约会。

sentences.en: You only date within your religion. But again, I was like, I'm just taking a vacation from all of that stress.
sentences.zh: 你只能在你的宗教内部约会。但话又说回来，我想，我只是在摆脱所有那些压力，给自己放个假。

sentences.en: I'm just going to see what this feels like.
sentences.zh: 我只是想看看这感觉如何。

sentences.en: And for a couple of weeks, it was, you know, man seeking woman.
sentences.zh: 有那么几个星期，你知道的，就是男寻找女。

sentences.en: And then I thought, what if I changed it to man seeking man?
sentences.zh: 然后我想，如果我把它改成男寻找男会怎么样？

sentences.en: Like, I remember like, kind of my finger on the mouse changing the designation from seeking female to male, and I was shaking, and I'm like, am I really going to do this?
sentences.zh: 我记得当时我的手指放在鼠标上，把交友意向从寻找女性改成男性，我在发抖，我在想，我真的要这么做吗？

sentences.en: And I was daring myself to do it. And I did it.
sentences.zh: 我当时是在给自己壮胆。然后我照做了。

sentences.en: Will made plans for lunch in downtown Portland with a younger guy named Jason.
sentences.zh: Will计划和一位名叫Jason的年轻人在波特兰市中心吃午饭。
